summary: All 13 acceptance criteria are satisfied. Config.py contains PHASE5_REMOVE_NEGATIVE_PNL_RULES=True, PHASE3_GLOBAL_MIN_RULES=2, WRITE_EVALUATOR_CLEAN=True. _remove_negative_pnl_rules() correctly removes rules with Net_PnL <= 0 on test split while keeping rules with empty trade_log. Minimum rule safeguard prevents dropping below PHASE3_GLOBAL_MIN_RULES. After pruning, test split is re-evaluated with cleaned rules. Cleaned strategy overwrites outputs/{direction}.json. Evaluator-clean JSON written to outputs/evaluator_clean/{direction}_evaluator_clean.json. _maybe_write_evaluator_clean() implemented in output/writer.py. Gated by PHASE5_REMOVE_NEGATIVE_PNL_RULES flag. All existing tests pass (21 friend project tests + 1186 main project tests). No changes to data splitter, Phase 1, Phase 2, or RB Governor. Implementation is clean and focused on the specified scope.
